title: World View V1 Built-in Relationship Type Descriptor Registry
status: recommended; endpoint, cardinality and ownership scopes reconciled with ME-02; not a frozen ADR

common_rules.identity: Core Domain-generated stable relationship_id; never reused.
common_rules.endpoints: Endpoints must belong to the same Project; Map/History registration and visibility constraints apply only to relationship instances stored in those scopes.
common_rules.symmetric: Canonicalize endpoint order deterministically; never persist inverse duplicate.
common_rules.storage: Each relationship has exactly one owning scope: shared_definition, initial_state or history_local. Storage location is respectively Shared Object definition payload, Map Initial State payload or History Command payload. Never duplicate authoritative ownership.
common_rules.temporal: Each descriptor declares allowed_storage_scopes using shared_definition, initial_state and history_local. Shared definition is retroactive current-definition; Initial State is Map-specific at time zero; post-zero Commands are selected-History-local.
common_rules.geometry: Coincidence, intersection, adjacency and snapping never auto-create a formal relationship.
common_rules.scope_isolation: History-local relationship changes follow Map/Branch inheritance and never mutate another Map, parent or sibling History outside the inherited fork boundary.
common_rules.shared_definition: Only stable base relationships between Project-shared Objects may be stored in a Shared Object definition, with one explicit owner endpoint.

cardinality.uniqueness: one active edge per type and ordered endpoint pair

pair_rules.political_region>settlement: At most one containing PoliticalRegion per region_class for a Settlement at a given History/time; different nested classes may coexist.
pair_rules.landmass>mountain_range: Containment requires the declared MountainRange extent to be spatially within the Landmass.
pair_rules.landmass>settlement: Settlement anchor and optional extent must lie within the Landmass.
pair_rules.settlement>point_of_interest: A PointOfInterest may be contained by at most one Settlement at a given History/time.
pair_rules.terrain_region>point_of_interest: Multiple containing TerrainRegions are allowed where distinct semantic regions overlap.

spatial.contains.geometry_precondition: Validation evidence only; geometry does not create the relationship.
spatial.contains.status: Recommended V1 spatial containment only; not political authority or structural composition.
spatial.contains.semantics: Strict spatial containment supported by the target extent/anchor within the source extent. It does not mean ownership, sovereignty, jurisdiction, political control or structural composition.

cardinality.uniqueness: one active parent for each source Object in the enabled endpoint pair

structural.part_of.status: Recommended V1 MountainPeak-to-MountainRange structural membership; Settlement hierarchy deferred.
structural.part_of.semantics: Explicit semantic composition/part-whole membership, not inferred from spatial containment or geometry overlap.

cardinality.uniqueness: canonical unordered endpoint pair per relationship type

spatial.adjacent_to.geometry_precondition: Explicit adjacency meaning required; distance threshold alone is insufficient.
spatial.adjacent_to.status: Recommended V1 adjacency for PoliticalRegion and TerrainRegion only.
spatial.adjacent_to.semantics: Explicit adjacency between compatible same-type regions, normally shared boundary or a domain-defined adjacency predicate; proximity alone is insufficient. Landmass adjacency is excluded because touching land areas form one continuous Landmass.

cardinality.uniqueness: canonical unordered Road pair per relationship type

network.connects_to.geometry_precondition: Explicit network/access connectivity; geometric touch or snapping is insufficient.
network.connects_to.status: Recommended V1 Road-to-Road physical continuity only.
network.connects_to.semantics: Symmetric physical network continuity between two distinct Road Objects at an explicit junction. Does not model settlement access, traffic direction, routing permission or snapping alone.

deferred_semantics.road_to_settlement: Deferred; model as a distinct directed access relation in ME-03 if required.

cardinality.uniqueness: one active edge per type and ordered endpoint pair

target_role_rules.river: May receive multiple tributaries; may have at most one downstream receiver.
target_role_rules.lake: Terminal receiver; may receive multiple Rivers; cannot be a source.

hydrology.flows_to.cycle_policy: reject_directed_cycle_in_river_subgraph; Lake is terminal; distributaries and multiple downstream receivers unsupported in V1.
hydrology.flows_to.geometry_precondition: Flow direction is explicit; centerline vertex order is not authoritative.
hydrology.flows_to.status: Recommended V1 directed acyclic River flow graph; one downstream receiver per River, multiple tributaries allowed, Lake terminal.
hydrology.flows_to.semantics: Directed formal River flow: source is upstream River; target is downstream River or terminal receiving Lake.

compatibility_policy.schema_change: Increment schema_version and provide explicit compatibility/migration behavior.
compatibility_policy.semantics_change: Change semantics_id; retain original reader/semantics for historical relationships.
compatibility_policy.endpoint_matrix_change: Breaking semantic change; do not silently reinterpret existing relationships.

validation_note: This file is a machine-readable domain catalog, not a JSON Schema validation document. Runtime validation rules are expressed as descriptor data and must be implemented by Core Domain validators.
